data.narrative:
Terrestrial Energy is a public-stage nuclear energy company that has raised $280M to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe consists of 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 6 private peers including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Peer-median valuation analysis is not applicable here. The nuclear energy sector contains only 5 same-stage comparable companies total, and filtering by adjacent stage or similar valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial bias given the narrow and heterogeneous nature of the comp set. This lack of sufficient narrow-band comparables prevents robust triangulation via revenue or EBITDA multiples at this stage.

The analysis therefore cannot support a specific valuation range based on the data provided. Key uncertainties driving valuation in this space include technology commercialization timelines, regulatory approval pathways, and capital intensity of deployment—none of which are quantified in the available dataset. A credible valuation would require either expansion of the comp set to include adjacent nuclear or decarbonization technologies, or primary analysis of Terrestrial Energy's specific development stage, technical milestones, and project pipeline. As currently scoped, the insufficient comparable universe prevents quantitative synthesis.
